originalWork: CornerAssembly.png is the current reference-derived blank chassis. CornerAssembly.gdshader draws live speed cells; ItemHudSlot draws selection and live optional resource bars. ItemAssembly.png and its shader are retained legacy artwork.

Wrench.svg, Missile.svg, Oil.svg, Nitro.svg, Salvo.svg, ProxyMine.svg and MachineGun.svg are project-created silhouettes. Nitro/MachineGun were refined against the approved corner-HUD concept; no external assets acquired.
Component.gdshader preserves the source textures and masks example values at runtime.
